SEP Handler — काग़ज़ बैकअप फ़ॉर्म

Paper backup forms · 9 sheets, one per handler form. Generated 2026-08-24 from the live form registry (2.1.0-alpha.8 build 5).

  1. Print A4 portrait, 100% scale, single-sided, black & white.
  2. Laminate one of each per area — VAT Room 1, VAT Room 2, Barrel Room, Pickling Area 4, Office.
  3. Keep a loose (un-laminated) pad of Production and Check-in beside each laminated set; those two fill up.
  4. Every row and block carries a ☐ In app tick — that tick is what the end-of-shift reconciliation counts against the dashboard's Adoption view.
  5. Devanagari renders through Noto Sans Devanagari; offline, the system Hindi font is used instead. Check one sheet before printing the set.

Regenerate after any change to the handler forms: pnpm paper:forms.
